title.en: PDF preview in its own window
title.zh: 在独立窗口中预览 PDF

body.en: Open the compiled PDF in a separate window, for example on a second monitor, with SyncTeX working both ways between the source and that window.
body.zh: 可以在单独的窗口中打开编译好的 PDF，比如放到第二台显示器上；源码和该窗口之间的 SyncTeX 双向跳转都可以使用。

body.en: New BasicTeX installs update their base packages, and the TeX doctor flags outdated packages with a one-click update.
body.zh: 新安装的 BasicTeX 会更新基础宏包；TeX 诊断会标出过时的宏包，并提供一键更新。

body.en: A brief download error (such as a 502 or a timeout) is retried, and if an update still fails you can try again or open the release page. Settings… (⌘,) and Check for Updates… are now in the Lattice menu, and Report a Problem… is in the Help menu.
body.zh: 短暂的下载错误（如 502 或超时）会自动重试；如果更新仍然失败，可以重试或打开发布页面。“设置…”（⌘,）和“检查更新…”已加入 Lattice 菜单，“报告问题…”已加入帮助菜单。

fixes.en: CVPR review-mode line numbers are no longer drawn over the text.
fixes.zh: CVPR 审稿模式的行号不会再盖住正文。

fixes.en: Accepting a citation suggestion after an unclosed \cite{ keeps the rest of the line. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
fixes.zh: 在未闭合的 \cite{ 后接受引用建议时，会保留这一行的其余内容。感谢 @ajay-mk。

fixes.en: In Add papers, the added paper's card keeps its borders, and a long citation key is shortened instead of overflowing.
fixes.zh: 在“添加论文”中，已添加论文的卡片边框不再被裁掉，过长的引用键会被截断而不是溢出。

fixes.en: Open Slide 2.3.2: slide thumbnails and the overview grid are left-aligned.
fixes.zh: Open Slide 2.3.2：幻灯片缩略图和概览网格改为左对齐。
